resource_envelope_pre_measurement.benchmark_method: actual KalshiArena.step, interleaved enabled/disabled variants, deterministic fake observations/clocks, isolated unchanged save/evaluate configuration, bounded in-memory diagnostic log sink. Record exact setups, trial counts, raw samples, CPU/wall distribution, source identity and limitations. No production or peak-load guarantee.

future_release_gate.account_state_restart_audit: Read-only before/after preserve consumed controls/caps/financial history, explain legitimate intervening events. No reset to make comparison pass.

postrelease_evidence_plan.selection: After terminal SUCCESS, original normal startup/account health and root exact-source verification, freeze the first future UTC quarter-hour window whose start is at least30s after completed root verification. Record boundary before it starts.
postrelease_evidence_plan.observation_bounds: One full900s window plus120s post-end tail; exactly one preregistered cohort, no moving bounds or silently replacing incomplete result.
postrelease_evidence_plan.primary_evidence: Diagnostic slot/early-disposition event and actual original learner receipt/counters, cause flags and available frame/receive/apply clocks. No claim of producer occurrence when absent.
postrelease_evidence_plan.retrieval: Finite filtered deployment-scoped batches after due slot and after window+tail. Limits/capped/errors/missing events and retrieval wallclocks retained. Any missing endpoint query unknown.
postrelease_evidence_plan.secondary: Bounded orders/fills/fees/settlement audit and currentreal/practice status; actual trading results are not test of strategyedge.
postrelease_evidence_plan.finish: Record diagnostic release and bounded observation, leave unresolved EXEC or predictive-skill claims open. Further correction only on evidence with separately reviewed source/quality protocol if needed.

precheck_limitations: Selected status precheck has future requested endpoint; valid for observed timestamped rows only. Service log metadata may name latest SKIPPED docs deployment; use actual active deployment evidence separately.
not_done: No source committed/pushed/deployed at declaration. No forecast/score/edge established.
